Title: General availability: Live Channels for Azure Media Services

Body.Content: Live Channels for Azure Media Services is generally available and backed by the full support of the Azure Service Level Agreement (SLA) for all customers. This is the same streaming solution that was used by more than ten leading international broadcasters to seamlessly deliver coverage of the 2014 World Cup. For more information, please visit the Media Services page or the Getting Started with Live Streaming blog post. For a comprehensive look at pricing, please visit the Media Services Pricing page.
